conflicts.departmental_wording_summary: The candidate source assigns a 30-calendar-day registration period to residents and a 60-calendar-day period to nonresidents after SIM-slot activation.
conflicts.official_source_summary: The current official tariff page groups resident and nonresident individuals together and distinguishes registration within 30 calendar days from registration after 30 days, measured from the first network event.
conflicts.required_decision: Confirm the current rule for nonresident registration timing and approve exact citizen-facing wording against the governing regulation and current operational tariff policy.
